The indicators of the app

Source: R/fct_data.R
indicators.Rd

The catalogue, one row per indicator: its id, whether it is for countries or regions (level), its topic, name and unit, the Eurostat dataset it comes from, the values that fix the other dimensions of that dataset (filters, such as sex=T;age=Y15-74) and a short definition.

The rows come from two files of inst/extdata: indicators.csv, written by hand, whose rows come first, and indicators_generated.csv, the series of the main tables of Eurostat, written by data-raw/build_indicators.R (generated is TRUE for these). A generated row with the same id, or the same level, dataset and filters, as a hand-written one is left out. A row added to indicators.csv adds an indicator to the app.

Usage

indicators()

Value

A data frame with one row per indicator.

Examples

indicators()[, c("id", "level", "name", "unit")]
